changelog: Playlists download several songs at once, and you can choose where new songs are saved.
The Phone tab keeps real music and hides ringtones, voice notes, call recordings, and screen recordings.
Mixes and Play for 10 to 45 minutes, with Next that keeps going until the time is up.
Smooth sound so full volume does not clip.
Drag to reorder the queue. Songs you already have are skipped.
The app can download and install a new version.
